advancerepair.mending_ii.description: Repairs the most damaged eligible item in your inventory at twice the normal Mending rate.
advancerepair.config.title: Advance Repair Configuration
advancerepair.advancement.not_right.desc: Craft the Mending II book with a note from HR.
advancerepair.book.title: A Message from HR
advancerepair.book.page1:
Dear player,

We know it has been a while since Advance Repair received an update.

We haven't forgotten about the mod.
advancerepair.book.page2:
We've been working behind the scenes on new ideas and improvements.

Thank you for still playing.

We are sorry for the long wait.

— HR
advancerepair.book.page3:
Psst...

You found an Easter Egg.

Or maybe...
the game found you.

Something isn't quite right...

Don't close this book yet.

It's already too late.

We weren't supposed to leave this page here.

If you can read this,
then HR knows you're here.

...and HR isn't the only one watching.
